name: pulse-health
description: Pulse Health patient portal: legacy Angular baseline plus a mock HTTP API

scripts.setup: npm run setup:api && npm run setup:web
scripts.setup:api: cd apps/mock-api && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip --quiet && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.lint: npm run lint:api && npm run lint:web
